_note: 2026-11-11 interactive (owner request): five rules mined from the InSilico chat dataset (research/insilico_rules.md), pre-registered BEFORE any result was computed. One walk-forward experiment each (5 new experiments). Common decision rule: ALIVE (candidate) only if WF OOS Sharpe > 0.8 net of costs AND robust.worst > 0 AND at least 75% of the grid is positive AND the effect has the same sign in both sub-periods (author's era 2020/21-2022, and 2023-2026). 'DEAD at taker costs' if gross (before costs) is positive in >= 75% of the grid but net is not. 'DEAD' otherwise. A rule that passes only before 2023 is recorded as 'regime-dependent: dead after 2022'. Nothing is promoted to a paper book in this session. Costs: Binance VIP0 taker 5 bp + modelled slippage, maker 2 bp; passive fills need a 1 bp trade-through; a stop is a market order; when a bar touches both the stop and a target the stop is assumed first; a target cannot fill in the bar of entry. Event books: 50% of equity per trade, at most 2 open trades. Diagnostics (single configs, tagged, never selected by the walk-forward): maker-entry case for lshock, the mirrored short side of tsize_capit / lshock / mousetrap, and the mousetrap without its size condition (control).
_tsize_capit: R1. Dataset bnts 1d = BTC, ETH, SOL on Binance USDT-M with trade-size buckets from aggTrades 2020-01-01..2026-10-31 (universe fixed before any result; chosen for download size only). UTC day t: bucket deltas of `scheme` (author7 = <30k,30-60k,60-110k,110-150k,150-250k,250-500k,>500k USD; fine12 = all 12 stored bins), ignoring buckets with less than `min_share` of the day's volume; if every remaining bucket is negative, go long that coin at the close of day t for `hold_days` (a new signal restarts the clock). Weight 1/3 per coin, no leverage. Also reported, not selected: forward 1/3/5-day return after signal days vs all days by sub-period (must beat the unconditional mean with t > 2 in BOTH for ALIVE), and the mirrored short (author says it does NOT work: expected <= 0).
_weekend_revert: R21. Dataset bn 1h, BTC and ETH only. F = close of the hour ending Friday 17:00 New York (CME close). At the close of the hour ending Sunday 18:00 New York (CME reopen): g = P/F - 1. If |g| >= thr take -sign(g) with weight 0.5 per coin. exit=fill: leave at the first hourly close after the hour's range has crossed F; both exits leave no later than Monday 17:00 New York.
_lshock: R5. Dataset bnm 1m = BTC ETH SOL XRP DOGE BNB ADA AVAX LINK LTC, 2021-01..2026-10. sigma = std of 1-min log returns over the previous 1440 bars, Vbar = mean 1-min quote volume over the previous 1440 bars. Climax bar t-1: return <= -z*sigma and volume >= m*Vbar. Reversal bar t: up bar, volume below the climax bar's, and it retraces at least fraction e of the climax bar's body. Origin O = highest high of bars t-10..t-1; L = lowest low of bars t-1..t. Buy at the close of bar t (taker). Sell half at L + 0.5*(O-L) and half at O (resting limits); if the first target is not above the entry everything exits at O. Stop 1 bp under L. Out at market after 60 bars. Long side only (the author's 'bounce capture').
_range_retest: R19. Dataset bnm 1m, same coins. ATR = mean (high-low) of the previous 60 bars = the author's 'average candle size'. Range = bars t-n..t-1 with (highest high - lowest low) <= tight*sqrt(n)*ATR. Breakout bar t: close above the range high RH with (high-low) >= 1.5*ATR. Resting bid at RH for the next n bars, first fill only (fill needs a 1 bp trade-through). Exit: resting offer at RH + 1*ATR; stop (market) at RH - s*ATR; out at market n bars after the fill. Mirrored for breakdowns (offer at the range low). Maker fee on entry and target.
_mousetrap: R4. Dataset bnts 5m = BTC, ETH, SOL 5-min bars 2021-01..2026-10 with small (< 30k USD per trade) and large (>= 60k USD) taker delta. Support S = lowest low of bars t-n..t-1. Trap bar t: low < S, close > S, volume >= vol_mult * mean 5-min volume of the previous 288 bars, small delta < 0 and large delta > 0. Buy at the close of bar t (taker); stop 1 bp under the trap bar's low; out at market after `hold` bars. No target (the author gives none).
_lshock_replication: Added 2026-11-11 after the lshock walk-forward (OOS 0.64, 4/8 configs positive: it FAILS the rule above and is not a candidate) and BEFORE downloading any of the data below. The literal reading of the rule (z=6, m=5, e=1.0: full engulf) made +70 bp net per trade over 302 trades on the 10 test coins (t 2.5), which one would expect to find by chance among 8 configs. Frozen-config replication on coins that were not in the test: the next 20 names after LTC in data.BN_SYMBOLS (DOT BCH TRX ATOM ETC XLM FIL NEAR UNI AAVE MATIC ARB OP APT SUI INJ SAND MANA AXS FTM), 1-min bars 2021-01..2026-10, same engine, same costs, long side, taker entry, no parameter changed. One single-config evaluation per 10-coin half (logged as config lines tagged 'replication'; no walk-forward, nothing selected). REPLICATED iff the pooled mean net return per trade is > 0 with t > 2 AND it is positive in both eras (to 2022, 2023+). Otherwise lshock is recorded as not replicated. Even if replicated it stays a candidate idea, not a book: ~50 trades a year on 10 coins.
